column1: # What MIT says each 6.006 lecture is about: the link text of the lecture
# This is the eval's ground truth, and the reason it is worth anything is that
# MIT wrote it for students rather than for this test. The eval's questions are
# phrased from these topic names; the expected first occurrence of a topic is
# the lowest-numbered lecture whose title covers it.
# Transcribed, not interpreted: the `Lecture N: ` prefix and the trailing
# ` notes (PDF)` are OCW page furniture and are stripped; a typographic
# apostrophe is normalised to an ASCII one. Nothing else is edited.
